## Automating to Speed Up Searches

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(purrr)
library(geosphere)
library(stringi)

calc_uncertainty_from_bbox <- function(bbox) {
  if (is.null(bbox) || length(bbox) < 4 || any(is.na(bbox))) return(NA_real_)
  bbox <- as.numeric(bbox)
  round(geosphere::distHaversine(c(bbox[3], bbox[1]), c(bbox[4], bbox[2])) / 2)
}

standardize_geocode_result <- function(df, uncertainty_col) {
  if (!"boundingbox" %in% names(df)) df$boundingbox <- vector("list", nrow(df))
  df %>% mutate("{uncertainty_col}" := map_dbl(boundingbox, calc_uncertainty_from_bbox))
}

safe_geocode_osm <- function(df, address_col, lat_name, lon_name, unc_name) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble(!!address_col := character(), !!lat_name := numeric(), !!lon_name := numeric(), !!unc_name := numeric()))
  }
  
  df_temp <- df %>% rename(temp_address = all_of(address_col))
  res <- geocode(df_temp, address = temp_address, method = "osm", lat = lat_temp, long = lon_temp, full_results = TRUE)
  res <- standardize_geocode_result(res, unc_name)
  
  if (!"lat_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lat_temp <- NA_real_
  if (!"lon_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lon_temp <- NA_real_
  
  res %>% 
    rename(!!address_col := temp_address, !!lat_name := lat_temp, !!lon_name := lon_temp) %>% 
    select(all_of(c(address_col, lat_name, lon_name, unc_name)))
}

clean_locality_text <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    stringi::stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>% 
    str_replace_all("[\\.,:;\\(\\)\\[\\]/-]", " ") %>% 
    str_squish()
}

simplify_locality_text <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- clean_locality_text(x)
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, regex("\\b(km|kilometer|carretera|road|near|cerca de|trocha|quebrada|qbrda|qda|fundo|comunidad|caserio|estacion|bosque|bordes|rocosos)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, "\\b[0-9]+\\b") %>% str_squish()
  ifelse(str_count(x_clean, "\\S+") > 5, str_extract(x_clean, "^(\\S+\\s+){0,4}\\S+"), x_clean) %>% str_squish()
}

verify_and_correct_coordinates <- function(data, distance_threshold_km = 20) {
  
  # Prepare parallel queries for the 5-level cascading search
  data_parsed <- data %>%
    mutate(
      .row_id = row_number(),
      lat_orig = as.numeric(decimalLatitude),
      lon_orig = as.numeric(decimalLongitude),
      
      loc_raw = str_squish(as.character(locality)),
      state_raw = str_squish(as.character(stateProvince)),
      is_empty_loc = is.na(loc_raw) | loc_raw == "",
      
      first_word = str_extract(clean_locality_text(loc_raw), "^\\S+"),
      
      query_loc = pmap_chr(list(loc_raw, state_raw, "Peru"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", "))),
      query_clean = pmap_chr(list(clean_locality_text(loc_raw), clean_locality_text(state_raw), "Peru"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", "))),
      query_simple = pmap_chr(list(simplify_locality_text(loc_raw), clean_locality_text(state_raw), "Peru"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", "))),
      query_first = pmap_chr(list(first_word, clean_locality_text(state_raw), "Peru"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", "))),
      query_state = pmap_chr(list(clean_locality_text(state_raw), "Peru"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", ")))
    )
  
  # Extract unique combinations to optimize API calls
  to_search <- data_parsed %>% 
    distinct(query_loc, query_clean, query_simple, query_first, query_state) %>% 
    filter(query_loc != "Peru")
  
  # Level 1: Full raw text
  geo_1 <- to_search %>% distinct(query_loc) %>% safe_geocode_osm("query_loc", "lat_1", "lon_1", "unc_1")
  failed_1 <- to_search %>% left_join(geo_1, by = "query_loc") %>% filter(is.na(lat_1))
  
  # Level 2: Cleaned text
  geo_2 <- failed_1 %>% distinct(query_clean) %>% safe_geocode_osm("query_clean", "lat_2", "lon_2", "unc_2")
  failed_2 <- failed_1 %>% left_join(geo_2, by = "query_clean") %>% filter(is.na(lat_2))
  
  # Level 3: Simplified text (without common ecological stop-words)
  geo_3 <- failed_2 %>% distinct(query_simple) %>% safe_geocode_osm("query_simple", "lat_3", "lon_3", "unc_3")
  failed_3 <- failed_2 %>% left_join(geo_3, by = "query_simple") %>% filter(is.na(lat_3))
  
  # Level 4: First word only
  geo_4 <- failed_3 %>% distinct(query_first) %>% safe_geocode_osm("query_first", "lat_4", "lon_4", "unc_4")
  failed_4 <- failed_3 %>% left_join(geo_4, by = "query_first") %>% filter(is.na(lat_4))
  
  # Level 5: State/Province only fallback
  geo_5 <- failed_4 %>% distinct(query_state) %>% safe_geocode_osm("query_state", "lat_5", "lon_5", "unc_5")
  
  # Consolidate all coordinates gathered from the cascading search
  geo_dictionary <- to_search %>%
    left_join(geo_1, by = "query_loc") %>%
    left_join(geo_2, by = "query_clean") %>%
    left_join(geo_3, by = "query_simple") %>%
    left_join(geo_4, by = "query_first") %>%
    left_join(geo_5, by = "query_state") %>%
    mutate(
      osm_lat = coalesce(lat_1, lat_2, lat_3, lat_4, lat_5),
      osm_lon = coalesce(lon_1, lon_2, lon_3, lon_4, lon_5),
      osm_unc = coalesce(unc_1, unc_2, unc_3, unc_4, unc_5)
    ) %>%
    select(query_loc, osm_lat, osm_lon, osm_unc)
  
  # Apply business logic and reassemble the final dataset
  data_final <- data_parsed %>%
    left_join(geo_dictionary, by = "query_loc") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      distance_error_km = if_else(!is.na(lon_orig) & !is.na(lat_orig) & !is.na(osm_lon) & !is.na(osm_lat),
                                   distHaversine(c(lon_orig, lat_orig), c(osm_lon, osm_lat)) / 1000, 
                                   NA_real_),
      
      has_original = !is.na(lat_orig) & !is.na(lon_orig) & lat_orig != 0,
      is_too_far = isTRUE(distance_error_km > distance_threshold_km),
      has_osm = !is.na(osm_lat),
      
      # Needs correction if it lacked coordinates OR if original coordinates were too far off
      needs_correction = (!has_original | is_too_far) & has_osm,
      
      # Apply exact uncertainty if distance is under 1km; otherwise randomly assign a default value
      coordinateUncertaintyInMeters = if_else(
        !is.na(distance_error_km) & distance_error_km <= 1,
        osm_unc,
        sample(c(517, 628, 758, 925), 1)
      ),
      
      # Replace coordinates where appropriate
      decimalLatitude = if_else(needs_correction, osm_lat, lat_orig),
      decimalLongitude = if_else(needs_correction, osm_lon, lon_orig),
      
      # Assign discard reasons FIRST to logically drive the ok.2 column
      discardReason = case_when(
        is_empty_loc & !has_original ~ "Impossible to correct. No coordinates or locality",
        is_empty_loc & has_original ~ "Not corrected, only coordinates or locality",
        needs_correction ~ "Corrected: points were corrected according to the locality",
        !needs_correction & has_original ~ "Left as original",
        TRUE ~ "Impossible to correct. Not enough georeferencing information"
      ),
      
      # ok.2 flag set to FALSE ONLY if coordinates remained the original valid ones. 
      # Everything else (corrected, or reviewed and deemed impossible) gets TRUE.
      ok.2 = if_else(discardReason == "Left as original", FALSE, TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Remove internal temporary variables while keeping the original dataset columns intact
    select(
      -lat_orig, -lon_orig, -loc_raw, -state_raw, -is_empty_loc, -first_word,
      -query_loc, -query_clean, -query_simple, -query_first, -query_state,
      -osm_lat, -osm_lon, -osm_unc, -distance_error_km, -has_original,
      -is_too_far, -has_osm, -needs_correction, -.row_id
    )
  
  return(data_final)
}

# Execute over the entire dataset
amaz_data <- read.csv("../data/Georreferencing/1.Raw/georef__AMAZ2024.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
processed_amaz_data <- verify_and_correct_coordinates(amaz_data)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(purrr)
library(geosphere)
library(stringi)

safe_geocode_arcgis <- function(df, address_col, lat_name, lon_name, chunk_size = 200) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble(!!address_col := character(), !!lat_name := numeric(), !!lon_name := numeric()))
  }
  
  df_temp <- df %>% rename(temp_address = all_of(address_col))
  
  chunks <- split(df_temp, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(df_temp)) / chunk_size))
  
  res <- purrr::imap_dfr(chunks, function(chunk, i) {
    message(sprintf("  -> Geocodificando lote %s de %s...", i, length(chunks)))
    geocode(chunk, address = temp_address, method = "arcgis", lat = lat_temp, long = lon_temp, quiet = TRUE)
  })
  
  if (!"lat_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lat_temp <- NA_real_
  if (!"lon_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lon_temp <- NA_real_
  
  res %>% 
    rename(!!address_col := temp_address, !!lat_name := lat_temp, !!lon_name := lon_temp) %>% 
    select(all_of(c(address_col, lat_name, lon_name)))
}

clean_locality_text <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    stringi::stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>% 
    str_replace_all("[\\.,:;\\(\\)\\[\\]/-]", " ") %>% 
    str_squish()
}

simplify_locality_text <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- clean_locality_text(x)
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, regex("\\b(km|kilometer|carretera|road|near|cerca de|trocha|quebrada|qbrda|qda|fundo|comunidad|caserio|estacion|bosque|bordes|rocosos)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, "\\b[0-9]+\\b") %>% str_squish()
  ifelse(str_count(x_clean, "\\S+") > 5, str_extract(x_clean, "^(\\S+\\s+){0,4}\\S+"), x_clean) %>% str_squish()
}

verify_and_correct_coordinates <- function(data, distance_threshold_km = 20) {
  
  if (!"countryCode" %in% names(data)) data$countryCode <- NA_character_
  if (!"stateProvince" %in% names(data)) data$stateProvince <- NA_character_
  if (!"discardReason" %in% names(data)) data$discardReason <- ""
  if (!"coordinateUncertaintyInMeters" %in% names(data)) data$coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <- NA_real_
  
  data_parsed <- data %>%
    mutate(
      lat_orig = as.numeric(decimalLatitude),
      lon_orig = as.numeric(decimalLongitude),
      discardReason_orig = as.character(discardReason),
      
      has_original = !is.na(lat_orig) & !is.na(lon_orig) & !(lat_orig == 0 & lon_orig == 0),
      
      loc_raw = str_squish(as.character(locality)),
      state_raw = str_squish(as.character(stateProvince)),
      is_empty_loc = is.na(loc_raw) | loc_raw == ""
    )
  
  to_reverse <- data_parsed %>%
    filter(is_empty_loc & has_original) %>%
    distinct(lat_orig, lon_orig)
  
  if (nrow(to_reverse) > 0) {
    message("Iniciando Reverse Geocoding (Buscando nombres para coordenadas sin texto)...")
    chunks_rev <- split(to_reverse, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(to_reverse)) / 200))
    
    rev_geo <- purrr::imap_dfr(chunks_rev, function(chunk, i) {
      message(sprintf("  -> Reverse Geocoding lote %s de %s...", i, length(chunks_rev)))
      reverse_geocode(chunk, lat = lat_orig, long = lon_orig, method = "arcgis", address = "rev_locality", quiet = TRUE)
    })
    
    data_parsed <- data_parsed %>%
      left_join(rev_geo, by = c("lat_orig", "lon_orig")) %>%
      mutate(
        reversed_flag = if_else(is_empty_loc & has_original & !is.na(rev_locality), TRUE, FALSE),
        locality = if_else(reversed_flag, rev_locality, as.character(locality)),
        loc_raw = str_squish(as.character(locality)),
        is_empty_loc = is.na(loc_raw) | loc_raw == ""
      ) %>%
      select(-rev_locality)
  } else {
    data_parsed <- data_parsed %>% mutate(reversed_flag = FALSE)
  }
  
  data_parsed <- data_parsed %>%
    mutate(
      query_clean = pmap_chr(list(clean_locality_text(loc_raw), clean_locality_text(state_raw), "Brazil"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", "))),
      query_simple = pmap_chr(list(simplify_locality_text(loc_raw), clean_locality_text(state_raw), "Brazil"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", "))),
      query_state = pmap_chr(list(clean_locality_text(state_raw), "Brazil"), ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", ")))
    )
  
  unique_queries <- data_parsed %>% 
    filter(!is_empty_loc) %>% 
    distinct(query_clean, query_simple, query_state) %>% 
    filter(query_clean != "Brazil")
  
  message("Iniciando Nivel 1: Búsqueda con texto limpio...")
  geo_1 <- unique_queries %>% distinct(query_clean) %>% safe_geocode_arcgis("query_clean", "lat_1", "lon_1")
  failed_1 <- unique_queries %>% left_join(geo_1, by = "query_clean") %>% filter(is.na(lat_1))
  
  message("Iniciando Nivel 2: Búsqueda con texto simplificado (para los que fallaron en el Nivel 1)...")
  geo_2 <- failed_1 %>% distinct(query_simple) %>% safe_geocode_arcgis("query_simple", "lat_2", "lon_2")
  failed_2 <- failed_1 %>% left_join(geo_2, by = "query_simple") %>% filter(is.na(lat_2))
  
  message("Iniciando Nivel 3: Búsqueda solo por Estado (para el resto)...")
  geo_3 <- failed_2 %>% distinct(query_state) %>% safe_geocode_arcgis("query_state", "lat_3", "lon_3")
  
  message("Consolidando resultados finales...")
  geo_dictionary <- unique_queries %>%
    left_join(geo_1, by = "query_clean") %>%
    left_join(geo_2, by = "query_simple") %>%
    left_join(geo_3, by = "query_state") %>%
    mutate(
      new_lat = coalesce(lat_1, lat_2, lat_3),
      new_lon = coalesce(lon_1, lon_2, lon_3)
    ) %>%
    select(query_clean, new_lat, new_lon)
  
  data_final <- data_parsed %>%
    left_join(geo_dictionary, by = "query_clean") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      distance_error_km = if_else(has_original & !is.na(new_lat),
                                   distHaversine(c(lon_orig, lat_orig), c(new_lon, new_lat)) / 1000, 
                                   NA_real_),
      
      is_too_far = isTRUE(distance_error_km > distance_threshold_km),
      needs_correction = (!has_original | is_too_far) & !is.na(new_lat),
      is_missing_country = is.na(countryCode) | str_squish(countryCode) == "",
      
      decimalLatitude = if_else(needs_correction, new_lat, lat_orig),
      decimalLongitude = if_else(needs_correction, new_lon, lon_orig),
      countryCode = if_else(is_missing_country, "BR", as.character(countryCode)),
      
      coordinateUncertaintyInMeters = if_else(
        needs_correction | is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters),
        as.numeric(sample(c(250, 400, 500, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1500, 1800), 1)),
        as.numeric(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters)
      ),
      
      change_notes = case_when(
        needs_correction & is_missing_country & reversed_flag ~ "Locality found via reverse geocoding; Coordinates corrected; CountryCode filled with BR",
        needs_correction & is_missing_country ~ "Coordinates corrected; CountryCode filled with BR",
        needs_correction & !is_missing_country ~ "Coordinates corrected",
        !needs_correction & is_missing_country & reversed_flag ~ "Locality found via reverse geocoding; CountryCode filled with BR",
        !needs_correction & !is_missing_country & reversed_flag ~ "Locality found via reverse geocoding",
        !needs_correction & is_missing_country ~ "CountryCode filled with BR",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      
      ok.2 = if_else(change_notes != "", TRUE, FALSE),
      
      discardReason = if_else(ok.2, 
                              if_else(is.na(discardReason_orig) | discardReason_orig == "", 
                                      paste0("Change: ", change_notes), 
                                      paste0(discardReason_orig, " | Change: ", change_notes)), 
                              discardReason_orig)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      -lat_orig, -lon_orig, -loc_raw, -state_raw, -is_empty_loc,
      -query_clean, -query_simple, -query_state, -reversed_flag,
      -new_lat, -new_lon, -distance_error_km, -has_original,
      -is_too_far, -needs_correction, -is_missing_country, 
      -change_notes, -discardReason_orig
    )
  
  message("¡Proceso terminado con éxito!")
  return(data_final)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(purrr)
library(geosphere)
library(stringi)

# Batch geocoding wrapper using ArcGIS
safe_geocode_arcgis <- function(df, address_col, lat_name, lon_name, chunk_size = 200) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble(!!address_col := character(), !!lat_name := numeric(), !!lon_name := numeric()))
  }
  
  df_temp <- df %>% rename(temp_address = all_of(address_col))
  chunks <- split(df_temp, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(df_temp)) / chunk_size))
  
  res <- purrr::imap_dfr(chunks, function(chunk, i) {
    message(sprintf("  -> Geocoding batch %s of %s...", i, length(chunks)))
    geocode(chunk, address = temp_address, method = "arcgis", lat = lat_temp, long = lon_temp, quiet = TRUE)
  })
  
  if (!"lat_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lat_temp <- NA_real_
  if (!"lon_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lon_temp <- NA_real_
  
  res %>% 
    rename(!!address_col := temp_address, !!lat_name := lat_temp, !!lon_name := lon_temp) %>% 
    select(all_of(c(address_col, lat_name, lon_name)))
}

# String normalization functions
clean_locality_text <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep("", length(x)))
  x %>% 
    stringi::stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>% 
    str_replace_all("[\\.,:;\\(\\)\\[\\]/-]", " ") %>% 
    str_squish()
}

simplify_locality_text <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- clean_locality_text(x)
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, regex("\\b(km|kilometer|carretera|road|near|cerca de|trocha|quebrada|qbrda|qda|fundo|comunidad|caserio|estacion|bosque|bordes|rocosos|vereda|corregimiento|municipio|vda|qda)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, "\\b[0-9]+\\b") %>% str_squish()
  ifelse(str_count(x_clean, "\\S+") > 5, str_extract(x_clean, "^(\\S+\\s+){0,4}\\S+"), x_clean) %>% str_squish()
}

# Main function: Forces Huila for stateProvince and validates coordinates
verify_and_correct_coordinates <- function(data, distance_threshold_km = 20) {
  
  # Ensure all necessary columns exist prior to processing
  required_cols <- c("country", "countryCode", "stateProvince", "locality", 
                     "decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude", "discardReason", "ok.2", "coordinateUncertaintyInMeters")
  
  for (col in required_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(data)) {
      if (col %in% c("decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude", "coordinateUncertaintyInMeters")) {
        data[[col]] <- NA_real_
      } else if (col == "ok.2") {
        data[[col]] <- FALSE
      } else {
        data[[col]] <- NA_character_
      }
    }
  }

  data_parsed <- data %>%
    mutate(
      lat_orig = as.numeric(decimalLatitude),
      lon_orig = as.numeric(decimalLongitude),
      discardReason_orig = as.character(discardReason),
      locality_orig = as.character(locality),
      
      # Determine fully empty records to exclude them from updates
      is_completely_blank = (is.na(country) | str_squish(country) == "") &
                            (is.na(countryCode) | str_squish(countryCode) == "") &
                            (is.na(stateProvince) | str_squish(stateProvince) == "") &
                            (is.na(locality_orig) | str_squish(locality_orig) == "") &
                            (is.na(lat_orig) | lat_orig == 0) &
                            (is.na(lon_orig) | lon_orig == 0),
                            
      has_original = !is.na(lat_orig) & !is.na(lon_orig) & !(lat_orig == 0 & lon_orig == 0),
      loc_raw = str_squish(locality_orig),
      is_empty_loc = is.na(loc_raw) | loc_raw == ""
    )
  
  # Reverse Geocoding ONLY to retrieve locality name if missing but coordinates exist
  to_reverse <- data_parsed %>%
    filter(!is_completely_blank & is_empty_loc & has_original) %>%
    distinct(lat_orig, lon_orig)
  
  if (nrow(to_reverse) > 0) {
    message("Starting Reverse Geocoding for missing text locations...")
    chunks_rev <- split(to_reverse, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(to_reverse)) / 200))
    
    rev_geo <- purrr::imap_dfr(chunks_rev, function(chunk, i) {
      message(sprintf("  -> Reverse Geocoding batch %s of %s...", i, length(chunks_rev)))
      reverse_geocode(chunk, lat = lat_orig, long = lon_orig, method = "arcgis", address = "rev_address", quiet = TRUE)
    })
    
    data_parsed <- data_parsed %>%
      left_join(rev_geo, by = c("lat_orig", "lon_orig")) %>%
      mutate(
        reversed_flag = if_else(!is_completely_blank & is_empty_loc & has_original & !is.na(rev_address), TRUE, FALSE),
        locality = if_else(reversed_flag, rev_address, locality_orig),
        loc_raw = str_squish(locality),
        is_empty_loc = is.na(loc_raw) | loc_raw == ""
      ) %>%
      select(-rev_address)
  } else {
    data_parsed <- data_parsed %>% mutate(reversed_flag = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Build search queries targeting Huila, Colombia directly
  data_parsed <- data_parsed %>%
    mutate(
      query_clean = pmap_chr(list(clean_locality_text(loc_raw), "Huila, Colombia"), 
                             ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", "))),
      query_simple = pmap_chr(list(simplify_locality_text(loc_raw), "Huila, Colombia"), 
                              ~ str_squish(paste(na.omit(c(...)[c(...) != ""]), collapse = ", ")))
    )
  
  unique_queries <- data_parsed %>% 
    filter(!is_completely_blank & !is_empty_loc & query_clean != "Huila, Colombia") %>% 
    distinct(query_clean, query_simple)
  
  # Forward Geocoding in Huila
  message("Starting Tier 1: Clean locality search in Huila...")
  geo_1 <- unique_queries %>% distinct(query_clean) %>% safe_geocode_arcgis("query_clean", "lat_1", "lon_1")
  failed_1 <- unique_queries %>% left_join(geo_1, by = "query_clean") %>% filter(is.na(lat_1))
  
  message("Starting Tier 2: Simplified locality search in Huila...")
  geo_2 <- failed_1 %>% distinct(query_simple) %>% safe_geocode_arcgis("query_simple", "lat_2", "lon_2")
  
  message("Consolidating geocoding results...")
  geo_dictionary <- unique_queries %>%
    left_join(geo_1, by = "query_clean") %>%
    left_join(geo_2, by = "query_simple") %>%
    mutate(
      new_lat = coalesce(lat_1, lat_2),
      new_lon = coalesce(lon_1, lon_2)
    ) %>%
    select(query_clean, new_lat, new_lon)
  
  # Final Data Assembly
  data_final <- data_parsed %>%
    left_join(geo_dictionary, by = "query_clean") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Measure distance error only if coordinates exist
      distance_error_km = if_else(has_original & !is.na(new_lat) & !is_completely_blank,
                                  distHaversine(c(lon_orig, lat_orig), c(new_lon, new_lat)) / 1000, 
                                  NA_real_),
      
      is_too_far = isTRUE(distance_error_km > distance_threshold_km),
      needs_correction = (!has_original | is_too_far) & !is.na(new_lat) & !is_completely_blank,
      
      # Assign mandatory metadata for non-blank rows
      country = if_else(is_completely_blank, country, "Colombia"),
      countryCode = if_else(is_completely_blank, countryCode, "CO"),
      stateProvince = if_else(is_completely_blank, stateProvince, "Huila"),
      
      # Retain original coordinates unless missing or distance exceeds threshold
      decimalLatitude = if_else(needs_correction, new_lat, lat_orig),
      decimalLongitude = if_else(needs_correction, new_lon, lon_orig),
      
      coordinateUncertaintyInMeters = if_else(
        !is_completely_blank & (needs_correction | is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters)),
        as.numeric(sample(c(250, 400, 500, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1500, 1800), 1)),
        as.numeric(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters)
      ),
      
      change_notes = case_when(
        is_completely_blank ~ "",
        needs_correction & reversed_flag ~ "Locality found via reverse geocoding; Coordinates corrected; Metadata set to Huila, Colombia/CO",
        needs_correction ~ "Coordinates corrected; Metadata set to Huila, Colombia/CO",
        !needs_correction & reversed_flag ~ "Locality found via reverse geocoding; Metadata set to Huila, Colombia/CO",
        TRUE ~ "Metadata set to Huila, Colombia/CO"
      ),
      
      ok.2 = if_else(change_notes != "", TRUE, FALSE),
      
      discardReason = if_else(ok.2, 
                              if_else(is.na(discardReason_orig) | discardReason_orig == "", 
                                      paste0("Change: ", change_notes), 
                                      paste0(discardReason_orig, " | Change: ", change_notes)), 
                              discardReason_orig)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      -lat_orig, -lon_orig, -loc_raw, -is_empty_loc,
      -query_clean, -query_simple, -reversed_flag,
      -new_lat, -new_lon, -distance_error_km, -has_original,
      -is_too_far, -needs_correction, -change_notes, -discardReason_orig,
      -locality_orig, -is_completely_blank
    )
  
  message("Process completed successfully!")
  return(data_final)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(purrr)
library(geosphere)
library(stringi)

# String normalization function to convert Latin diacritics to ASCII and clean special characters
remove_accents_and_clean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  x %>%
    stringi::stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s,\\.-]", "") %>%
    str_squish()
}

# Batch geocoding wrapper using ArcGIS with multi-field administrative boundary extraction
safe_geocode_arcgis <- function(df, address_col, lat_name, lon_name, state_name = NULL, chunk_size = 200) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    res_tb <- tibble(!!address_col := character(), !!lat_name := numeric(), !!lon_name := numeric())
    if (!is.null(state_name)) res_tb[[state_name]] <- character()
    return(res_tb)
  }
  
  df_temp <- df %>% rename(temp_address = all_of(address_col))
  chunks <- split(df_temp, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(df_temp)) / chunk_size))
  
  res <- purrr::imap_dfr(chunks, function(chunk, i) {
    message(sprintf("  -> Geocoding batch %s of %s...", i, length(chunks)))
    geocode(chunk, address = temp_address, method = "arcgis", lat = lat_temp, long = lon_temp, full_results = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  })
  
  if (!"lat_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lat_temp <- NA_real_
  if (!"lon_temp" %in% names(res)) res$lon_temp <- NA_real_
  
  # Coalesce administrative division candidates from ArcGIS output fields
  state_candidate_cols <- c("Region", "region", "Subregion", "subregion", "State", "state", "admin1", "Territory")
  found_state_cols <- intersect(state_candidate_cols, names(res))
  
  if (length(found_state_cols) > 0) {
    res$extracted_state <- dplyr::coalesce(!!!res[found_state_cols])
  } else {
    res$extracted_state <- NA_character_
  }
  
  res <- res %>% 
    rename(!!address_col := temp_address, !!lat_name := lat_temp, !!lon_name := lon_temp)
  
  if (!is.null(state_name)) {
    res <- res %>% rename(!!state_name := extracted_state)
    cols_to_select <- c(address_col, lat_name, lon_name, state_name)
  } else {
    cols_to_select <- c(address_col, lat_name, lon_name)
  }
  
  res %>% select(all_of(cols_to_select))
}

# String normalization functions for multi-language text cleaning
clean_locality_text <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep("", length(x)))
  x %>% 
    stringi::stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>% 
    str_replace_all("[\\.,:;\\(\\)\\[\\]/-]", " ") %>% 
    str_squish()
}

simplify_locality_text <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- clean_locality_text(x)
  stopwords_geo <- "\\b(km|kilometer|kilometro|carretera|road|near|cerca de|perto de|trocha|quebrada|qbrda|qda|fundo|comunidad|caserio|estacion|bosque|bordes|rocosos|vereda|corregimiento|municipio|vda|rio|river|lake|lago)\\b"
  
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, regex(stopwords_geo, ignore_case = TRUE))
  x_clean <- str_remove_all(x_clean, "\\b[0-9]+\\b") %>% str_squish()
  ifelse(str_count(x_clean, "\\S+") > 5, str_extract(x_clean, "^(\\S+\\s+){0,4}\\S+"), x_clean) %>% str_squish()
}

# Dynamic spatial search query builder
build_geo_query <- function(loc, state, ctry) {
  parts <- c(loc, state, ctry)
  parts <- parts[!is.na(parts) & str_squish(parts) != ""]
  if (length(parts) == 0) return("")
  str_squish(paste(parts, collapse = ", "))
}

# Main function: Global coordinate verification, state imputation, ASCII normalization, and audit logging
verify_and_correct_coordinates_global <- function(data, distance_threshold_km = 20) {
  
  # Ensure all target columns exist prior to processing
  required_cols <- c("country", "countryCode", "stateProvince", "locality", 
                     "decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude", "discardReason", "ok.2", "coordinateUncertaintyInMeters")
  
  for (col in required_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(data)) {
      if (col %in% c("decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude", "coordinateUncertaintyInMeters")) {
        data[[col]] <- NA_real_
      } else if (col == "ok.2") {
        data[[col]] <- FALSE
      } else {
        data[[col]] <- NA_character_
      }
    }
  }

  data_parsed <- data %>%
    mutate(
      lat_orig = as.numeric(decimalLatitude),
      lon_orig = as.numeric(decimalLongitude),
      discardReason_orig = as.character(discardReason),
      locality_orig = remove_accents_and_clean(as.character(locality)),
      state_orig = remove_accents_and_clean(as.character(stateProvince)),
      
      has_original = !is.na(lat_orig) & !is.na(lon_orig) & !(lat_orig == 0 & lon_orig == 0),
      loc_raw = str_squish(locality_orig),
      is_empty_loc = is.na(loc_raw) | loc_raw == "",
      
      # Flag records completely missing spatial or textual location data
      is_uncorrectable = !has_original & is_empty_loc
    )
  
  # Step 1: Reverse Geocoding to recover missing locality AND retrieve state/province directly from coordinates
  to_reverse <- data_parsed %>%
    filter(!is_uncorrectable & has_original & (is_empty_loc | is.na(state_orig) | str_squish(state_orig) == "")) %>%
    distinct(lat_orig, lon_orig)
  
  if (nrow(to_reverse) > 0) {
    message("Starting Reverse Geocoding for coordinate-based administrative (State/Province) and locality lookup...")
    chunks_rev <- split(to_reverse, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(to_reverse)) / 200))
    
    rev_geo <- purrr::imap_dfr(chunks_rev, function(chunk, i) {
      message(sprintf("  -> Reverse Geocoding batch %s of %s...", i, length(chunks_rev)))
      reverse_geocode(chunk, lat = lat_orig, long = lon_orig, method = "arcgis", address = "rev_address", full_results = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
    })
    
    # Extract state/province from potential returned fields
    state_candidate_cols <- c("Region", "region", "Subregion", "subregion", "State", "state", "admin1")
    found_rev_cols <- intersect(state_candidate_cols, names(rev_geo))
    
    if (length(found_rev_cols) > 0) {
      rev_geo$Region_extracted <- dplyr::coalesce(!!!rev_geo[found_rev_cols])
    } else {
      rev_geo$Region_extracted <- NA_character_
    }
    
    if (!"rev_address" %in% names(rev_geo)) rev_geo$rev_address <- NA_character_
    
    data_parsed <- data_parsed %>%
      left_join(rev_geo %>% select(lat_orig, lon_orig, rev_address, Region_extracted), by = c("lat_orig", "lon_orig")) %>%
      mutate(
        reversed_flag = if_else(!is_uncorrectable & is_empty_loc & has_original & !is.na(rev_address), TRUE, FALSE),
        locality = if_else(reversed_flag, rev_address, locality_orig),
        loc_raw = str_squish(locality),
        is_empty_loc = is.na(loc_raw) | loc_raw == "",
        
        # Store state derived from original coordinates
        rev_state = remove_accents_and_clean(Region_extracted)
      ) %>%
      select(-rev_address, -Region_extracted)
  } else {
    data_parsed <- data_parsed %>% mutate(reversed_flag = FALSE, rev_state = NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Step 2: Dynamic Search Query Assembly (Multi-country support)
  data_parsed <- data_parsed %>%
    mutate(
      temp_state = if_else(!is.na(state_orig) & str_squish(state_orig) != "", state_orig, rev_state),
      loc_clean_tmp = clean_locality_text(loc_raw),
      loc_simp_tmp = simplify_locality_text(loc_raw),
      
      query_clean = pmap_chr(list(loc_clean_tmp, temp_state, country), build_geo_query),
      query_simple = pmap_chr(list(loc_simp_tmp, temp_state, country), build_geo_query)
    ) %>%
    select(-loc_clean_tmp, -loc_simp_tmp, -temp_state)
  
  unique_queries <- data_parsed %>% 
    filter(!is_uncorrectable & !is_empty_loc & query_clean != "") %>% 
    distinct(query_clean, query_simple)
  
  # Step 3: Forward Geocoding with State/Province Extraction from Locality text
  message("Starting Tier 1: Clean locality global search...")
  geo_1 <- unique_queries %>% distinct(query_clean) %>% safe_geocode_arcgis("query_clean", "lat_1", "lon_1", "state_1")
  failed_1 <- unique_queries %>% left_join(geo_1, by = "query_clean") %>% filter(is.na(lat_1))
  
  message("Starting Tier 2: Simplified locality global search...")
  geo_2 <- failed_1 %>% distinct(query_simple) %>% safe_geocode_arcgis("query_simple", "lat_2", "lon_2", "state_2")
  
  message("Consolidating geocoding results and administrative divisions...")
  geo_dictionary <- unique_queries %>%
    left_join(geo_1, by = "query_clean") %>%
    left_join(geo_2, by = "query_simple") %>%
    mutate(
      new_lat = coalesce(lat_1, lat_2),
      new_lon = coalesce(lon_1, lon_2),
      new_state = remove_accents_and_clean(coalesce(state_1, state_2))
    ) %>%
    select(query_clean, new_lat, new_lon, new_state)
  
  # Step 4: Final Data Assembly, State Fallback, and ASCII Character Normalization
  data_final <- data_parsed %>%
    left_join(geo_dictionary, by = "query_clean") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate spatial error distance when original coordinates exist
      distance_error_km = if_else(has_original & !is.na(new_lat) & !is_uncorrectable,
                                  distHaversine(c(lon_orig, lat_orig), c(new_lon, new_lat)) / 1000, 
                                  NA_real_),
      
      is_too_far = isTRUE(distance_error_km > distance_threshold_km),
      needs_correction = (!has_original | is_too_far) & !is.na(new_lat) & !is_uncorrectable,
      
      # Hierarchical state/province assignment:
      # 1. Original cleaned state
      # 2. State from coordinate reverse geocoding
      # 3. State from locality forward geocoding
      stateProvince = case_when(
        !is.na(state_orig) & str_squish(state_orig) != "" ~ state_orig,
        !is.na(rev_state) & str_squish(rev_state) != "" ~ rev_state,
        !is.na(new_state) & str_squish(new_state) != "" ~ new_state,
        TRUE ~ state_orig
      ),
      
      # Final ASCII sanitation to guarantee standard international character formatting
      stateProvince = remove_accents_and_clean(stateProvince),
      locality = remove_accents_and_clean(locality),
      
      # Update coordinates if original are missing or exceed spatial error threshold
      decimalLatitude = if_else(needs_correction, new_lat, lat_orig),
      decimalLongitude = if_else(needs_correction, new_lon, lon_orig),
      
      # Update coordinate uncertainty in meters
      coordinateUncertaintyInMeters = if_else(
        !is_uncorrectable & (needs_correction | is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters)),
        as.numeric(sample(c(250, 400, 500, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1500, 1800), 1)),
        as.numeric(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters)
      ),
      
      # Audit change tracking
      change_notes = case_when(
        is_uncorrectable ~ "Impossible to correct, since no location information is available for this record",
        needs_correction & reversed_flag ~ "Locality recovered via spatial lookup; Coordinates updated through geospatial cross-referencing",
        needs_correction ~ "Coordinates updated through geospatial cross-referencing based on locality match",
        !needs_correction & reversed_flag ~ "Locality recovered via spatial lookup",
        (is.na(state_orig) | str_squish(state_orig) == "") & !is.na(stateProvince) & str_squish(stateProvince) != "" ~ "Administrative division (State/Province) updated via geospatial cross-referencing",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      
      ok.2 = if_else(change_notes != "", TRUE, as.logical(ok.2)),
      
      # Update discardReason with professional logging
      discardReason = case_when(
        is_uncorrectable ~ "Impossible to correct, since no location information is available for this record",
        change_notes != "" & (is.na(discardReason_orig) | discardReason_orig == "") ~ paste0("Change: ", change_notes),
        change_notes != "" ~ paste0(discardReason_orig, " | Change: ", change_notes),
        TRUE ~ discardReason_orig
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      -lat_orig, -lon_orig, -loc_raw, -is_empty_loc, -state_orig,
      -query_clean, -query_simple, -reversed_flag, -rev_state,
      -new_lat, -new_lon, -new_state, -distance_error_km, -has_original,
      -is_too_far, -needs_correction, -change_notes, -discardReason_orig,
      -locality_orig, -is_uncorrectable
    )
  
  message("Global coordinate processing, ASCII normalization, and administrative alignment completed successfully!")
  return(data_final)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(purrr)
library(stringi)

# String normalization: Converts Latin accents/diacritics to ASCII and removes illegal characters
clean_ascii_text <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  x %>%
    stringi::stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s,\\.-]", "") %>%
    str_squish()
}

# Helper function to consolidate administrative division fields from ArcGIS output
extract_arcgis_state <- function(df_res) {
  candidate_cols <- c("Region", "region", "Subregion", "subregion", "State", "state", "admin1", "Territory", "District")
  found_cols <- intersect(candidate_cols, names(df_res))
  
  if (length(found_cols) > 0) {
    dplyr::coalesce(!!!df_res[found_cols])
  } else {
    rep(NA_character_, nrow(df_res))
  }
}

# Standalone function: Forces state/province population through multi-stage geospatial fallback
impute_state_province <- function(data, chunk_size = 200) {
  
  # Ensure mandatory columns exist in dataset
  required_cols <- c("country", "stateProvince", "locality", "decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude", "discardReason", "ok.2")
  for (col in required_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(data)) {
      if (col %in% c("decimalLatitude", "decimalLongitude")) {
        data[[col]] <- NA_real_
      } else if (col == "ok.2") {
        data[[col]] <- FALSE
      } else {
        data[[col]] <- NA_character_
      }
    }
  }

  data_proc <- data %>%
    mutate(
      lat_num = as.numeric(decimalLatitude),
      lon_num = as.numeric(decimalLongitude),
      state_orig = clean_ascii_text(as.character(stateProvince)),
      locality_clean = clean_ascii_text(as.character(locality)),
      country_clean = clean_ascii_text(as.character(country)),
      discardReason_orig = as.character(discardReason),
      
      has_coords = !is.na(lat_num) & !is.na(lon_num) & !(lat_num == 0 & lon_num == 0),
      has_locality = !is.na(locality_clean) & str_squish(locality_clean) != "",
      needs_state = is.na(state_orig) | str_squish(state_orig) == ""
    )

  # STAGE 1: Force State Extraction via Coordinate Reverse Geocoding
  rev_targets <- data_proc %>%
    filter(needs_state & has_coords) %>%
    distinct(lat_num, lon_num)

  rev_results <- tibble()
  if (nrow(rev_targets) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("Stage 1: Reverse geocoding %s distinct coordinates to force state extraction...", nrow(rev_targets)))
    rev_chunks <- split(rev_targets, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(rev_targets)) / chunk_size))
    
    rev_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(rev_chunks, function(chunk, i) {
      message(sprintf("  -> Processing reverse geocoding batch %s of %s...", i, length(rev_chunks)))
      res <- reverse_geocode(chunk, lat = lat_num, long = lon_num, method = "arcgis", full_results = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
      res$state_from_coords <- extract_arcgis_state(res)
      res %>% select(lat_num, lon_num, state_from_coords)
    })
  }

  data_proc <- data_proc %>%
    left_join(rev_results, by = c("lat_num", "lon_num")) %>%
    mutate(
      state_from_coords = clean_ascii_text(state_from_coords),
      state_working = if_else(needs_state & !is.na(state_from_coords) & str_squish(state_from_coords) != "",
                              state_from_coords, state_orig),
      still_needs_state = is.na(state_working) | str_squish(state_working) == ""
    )

  # STAGE 2: Force State Extraction via Locality + Country Forward Geocoding
  fwd_targets <- data_proc %>%
    filter(still_needs_state & has_locality) %>%
    mutate(geo_query = if_else(!is.na(country_clean) & country_clean != "",
                               paste(locality_clean, country_clean, sep = ", "),
                               locality_clean)) %>%
    distinct(geo_query)

  fwd_results <- tibble()
  if (nrow(fwd_targets) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("Stage 2: Forward geocoding %s distinct localities to force state extraction...", nrow(fwd_targets)))
    fwd_chunks <- split(fwd_targets, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(fwd_targets)) / chunk_size))
    
    fwd_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(fwd_chunks, function(chunk, i) {
      message(sprintf("  -> Processing forward geocoding batch %s of %s...", i, length(fwd_chunks)))
      res <- geocode(chunk, address = geo_query, method = "arcgis", full_results = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
      res$state_from_locality <- extract_arcgis_state(res)
      res %>% select(geo_query, state_from_locality)
    })
  }

  data_proc <- data_proc %>%
    mutate(geo_query = if_else(still_needs_state & has_locality,
                               if_else(!is.na(country_clean) & country_clean != "",
                                       paste(locality_clean, country_clean, sep = ", "),
                                       locality_clean),
                               NA_character_)) %>%
    left_join(fwd_results, by = "geo_query") %>%
    mutate(
      state_from_locality = clean_ascii_text(state_from_locality),
      final_state = case_when(
        !is.na(state_working) & str_squish(state_working) != "" ~ state_working,
        !is.na(state_from_locality) & str_squish(state_from_locality) != "" ~ state_from_locality,
        TRUE ~ state_orig
      ),
      
      # Audit flags
      state_populated = (is.na(state_orig) | str_squish(state_orig) == "") & (!is.na(final_state) & str_squish(final_state) != ""),
      is_uncorrectable = (is.na(final_state) | str_squish(final_state) == "") & !has_coords & !has_locality
    )

  # Final dataset output formatting and logging
  data_final <- data_proc %>%
    mutate(
      stateProvince = clean_ascii_text(final_state),
      locality = clean_ascii_text(locality),
      
      change_note = case_when(
        is_uncorrectable ~ "Impossible to correct, since no spatial or text location information is available to infer administrative division",
        state_populated ~ "Administrative division (State/Province) populated via geospatial lookup",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      
      ok.2 = if_else(change_note != "", TRUE, as.logical(ok.2)),
      
      discardReason = case_when(
        is_uncorrectable ~ "Impossible to correct, since no spatial or text location information is available to infer administrative division",
        change_note != "" & (is.na(discardReason_orig) | discardReason_orig == "") ~ paste0("Change: ", change_note),
        change_note != "" ~ paste0(discardReason_orig, " | Change: ", change_note),
        TRUE ~ discardReason_orig
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      -lat_num, -lon_num, -state_orig, -locality_clean, -country_clean,
      -has_coords, -has_locality, -needs_state, -state_from_coords,
      -state_working, -still_needs_state, -geo_query, -state_from_locality,
      -final_state, -state_populated, -is_uncorrectable, -change_note, -discardReason_orig
    )

  message("State/Province forced imputation completed successfully!")
  return(data_final)
}
```

# Clean the data (there are many rows with empty coordinates)


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(purrr)
library(stringi)

# String normalization function to convert Latin diacritics to ASCII and clean special characters
remove_accents_and_clean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  x %>%
    stringi::stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s,\\.-]", "") %>%
    str_squish()
}

# Function to sanitize and filter non-geographic locality noise
sanitize_locality <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  x_clean <- remove_accents_and_clean(as.character(x))
  
  junk_pattern <- regex(
    "\\b(no data|sin datos|desconocid[oa]|unknown|n/a|null|no registrado|unspecified|not recorded|sin localidad|no location|sin informacion)\\b", 
    ignore_case = TRUE
  )
  
  is_junk <- str_detect(x_clean, junk_pattern) & str_count(x_clean, "\\S+") < 5
  x_clean[is_junk] <- NA_character_
  
  too_long <- !is.na(x_clean) & (nchar(x_clean) > 120 | str_count(x_clean, "\\S+") > 12)
  x_clean[too_long] <- str_extract(x_clean[too_long], "^(\\S+\\s+){0,9}\\S+") %>% str_squish()
  
  return(x_clean)
}

# Helper function to coalesce administrative division (State/Province) fields from ArcGIS output
extract_arcgis_state <- function(df_res) {
  candidate_cols <- c("Region", "region", "Subregion", "subregion", "State", "state", "admin1", "Territory", "District")
  found_cols <- intersect(candidate_cols, names(df_res))
  if (length(found_cols) > 0) {
    dplyr::coalesce(!!!df_res[found_cols])
  } else {
    rep(NA_character_, nrow(df_res))
  }
}

# Helper function to coalesce granular locality fields from ArcGIS output
extract_arcgis_locality <- function(df_res) {
  candidate_cols <- c("PlaceName", "Neighborhood", "City", "Subregion", "Address", "Match_addr")
  found_cols <- intersect(candidate_cols, names(df_res))
  if (length(found_cols) > 0) {
    dplyr::coalesce(!!!df_res[found_cols])
  } else {
    rep(NA_character_, nrow(df_res))
  }
}

# 1. Preserve original column schema and row index
columnas_originales <- names(literature2024_data)
columnas_objetivo <- union(columnas_originales, c("ok.2", "discardReason", "georef_class"))

processed_literature2024 <- literature2024_data %>%
  mutate(.row_id = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(
    ok.2 = if ("ok.2" %in% names(.)) as.logical(ok.2) else TRUE,
    discardReason = NA_character_,
    georef_class = if ("georef_class" %in% names(.)) as.character(georef_class) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    locality = sanitize_locality(locality),
    stateProvince = remove_accents_and_clean(as.character(stateProvince)),
    country = remove_accents_and_clean(as.character(country))
  )

# 2. Categorize each record based on available spatial and textual data
processed_literature2024 <- processed_literature2024 %>%
  mutate(
    lat_num = as.numeric(decimalLatitude),
    lon_num = as.numeric(decimalLongitude),
    
    has_text = (!is.na(country) & str_trim(country) != "") & 
               (!is.na(stateProvince) & str_trim(stateProvince) != "") & 
               (!is.na(locality) & str_trim(locality) != ""),
               
    has_coords = !is.na(lat_num) & !is.na(lon_num) & !(lat_num == 0 & lon_num == 0),
    
    is_uncorrectable = !has_coords & 
                      (is.na(locality) | str_trim(locality) == "") & 
                      (is.na(stateProvince) | str_trim(stateProvince) == ""),
    
    escenario = case_when(
      is_uncorrectable ~ "uncorrectable",
      has_text & has_coords ~ "validar",     
      has_text & !has_coords ~ "solo_texto", 
      !has_text & has_coords ~ "solo_coords",
      TRUE ~ "solo_texto"
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# CASE 1: TEXT ONLY (Missing coordinates)
# ==============================================================================
df_solo_texto <- processed_literature2024 %>% filter(escenario == "solo_texto")

if (nrow(df_solo_texto) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("Processing %s rows in 'solo_texto' scenario...", nrow(df_solo_texto)))
  
  df_solo_texto <- df_solo_texto %>%
    mutate(busqueda = pmap_chr(list(locality, stateProvince, country), function(loc, st, ctry) {
      parts <- c(loc, st, ctry)
      parts <- parts[!is.na(parts) & str_squish(parts) != ""]
      paste(parts, collapse = ", ")
    })) %>%
    geocode(address = busqueda, method = "arcgis", lat = lat_nueva, long = lon_nueva, full_results = TRUE, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      state_extracted = remove_accents_and_clean(extract_arcgis_state(.)),
      loc_extracted = sanitize_locality(extract_arcgis_locality(.)),
      
      stateProvince = if_else(is.na(stateProvince) | str_trim(stateProvince) == "", state_extracted, stateProvince),
      locality = if_else(is.na(locality) | str_trim(locality) == "", loc_extracted, locality),
      
      decimalLatitude = if_else(!is.na(lat_nueva), lat_nueva, lat_num),
      decimalLongitude = if_else(!is.na(lon_nueva), lon_nueva, lon_num),
      discardReason = NA_character_,
      ok.2 = TRUE
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# CASE 2: COORDINATES ONLY (Missing text)
# ==============================================================================
df_solo_coords <- processed_literature2024 %>% filter(escenario == "solo_coords")

if (nrow(df_solo_coords) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("Processing %s rows in 'solo_coords' scenario...", nrow(df_solo_coords)))
  
  df_solo_coords <- df_solo_coords %>%
    reverse_geocode(lat = lat_num, long = lon_num, method = "arcgis", full_results = TRUE, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      state_extracted = remove_accents_and_clean(extract_arcgis_state(.)),
      country_extracted = if ("CountryCode" %in% names(.)) remove_accents_and_clean(CountryCode) else NA_character_,
      locality_extracted = sanitize_locality(extract_arcgis_locality(.)),
      
      country = if_else(is.na(country) | str_trim(country) == "", country_extracted, country),
      stateProvince = if_else(is.na(stateProvince) | str_trim(stateProvince) == "", state_extracted, stateProvince),
      locality = if_else(is.na(locality) | str_trim(locality) == "", locality_extracted, locality),
      discardReason = NA_character_,
      ok.2 = TRUE
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# CASE 3: VALIDATE (All fields populated)
# ==============================================================================
df_validar <- processed_literature2024 %>% filter(escenario == "validar")

if (nrow(df_validar) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("Processing %s rows in 'validar' scenario...", nrow(df_validar)))
  
  df_validar <- df_validar %>%
    reverse_geocode(lat = lat_num, long = lon_num, method = "arcgis", address = "dir_inversa", full_results = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
    
  if (!"CountryCode" %in% names(df_validar)) df_validar$CountryCode <- NA_character_

  df_validar <- df_validar %>%
    mutate(
      state_extracted = remove_accents_and_clean(extract_arcgis_state(.)),
      CountryCode_clean = remove_accents_and_clean(as.character(CountryCode)),
      
      coincide_pais = map2_lgl(country, CountryCode_clean, function(ctry, code) {
        if (is.na(ctry) || is.na(code) || str_trim(code) == "") return(FALSE)
        str_detect(str_to_lower(ctry), str_to_lower(code))
      }),
      
      stateProvince = if_else(is.na(stateProvince) | str_trim(stateProvince) == "", state_extracted, stateProvince),
      busqueda = if_else(!coincide_pais, paste(locality, stateProvince, country, sep = ", "), NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    geocode(address = busqueda, method = "arcgis", lat = lat_nueva, long = lon_nueva, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      decimalLatitude = if_else(!is.na(lat_nueva), lat_nueva, lat_num),
      decimalLongitude = if_else(!is.na(lon_nueva), lon_nueva, lon_num),
      discardReason = NA_character_,
      ok.2 = if_else(!is.na(lat_nueva), TRUE, ok.2)
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# CASE 4: UNCORRECTABLE RECORDS
# ==============================================================================
df_uncorrectable <- processed_literature2024 %>% 
  filter(escenario == "uncorrectable") %>%
  mutate(
    ok.2 = FALSE,
    discardReason = NA_character_
  )

# ==============================================================================
# FINAL ASSEMBLY, REORDERING, AND SCHEMA CLEANUP
# ==============================================================================
processed_literature2024 <- bind_rows(df_solo_texto, df_solo_coords, df_validar, df_uncorrectable) %>%
  arrange(.row_id) %>%
  mutate(
    locality = sanitize_locality(locality),
    stateProvince = remove_accents_and_clean(stateProvince),
    discardReason = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(columnas_objetivo))

# Remove temporary dataframes and reclaim memory
rm(df_solo_texto, df_solo_coords, df_validar, df_uncorrectable, columnas_originales, columnas_objetivo)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# GEOCODIFICACIÓN INVERSA Y ACTUALIZACIÓN CON FORMATO DE PAÍS / COUNTRYCODE
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Cargar librerías necesarias
if (!requireNamespace("tidygeocoder", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidygeocoder")
if (!requireNamespace("countrycode", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("countrycode")
if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!requireNamespace("stringr", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("stringr")

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(countrycode)

# Asegurar que la columna countryCode exista en el dataframe
if (!"countryCode" %in% names(processed_literature2024)) {
  processed_literature2024$countryCode <- NA_character_
}

# 2. Filtrar las filas del rango 3080:3143 que tengan coordenadas válidas
filas_a_procesar <- processed_literature2024 %>%
  mutate(fila_id = row_number()) %>%
  filter(
    fila_id >= 3080 & fila_id <= 3143,
    !is.na(decimalLatitude) & !is.na(decimalLongitude),
    str_trim(as.character(decimalLatitude)) != "",
    str_trim(as.character(decimalLongitude)) != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lat_num = as.numeric(as.character(decimalLatitude)),
    lon_num = as.numeric(as.character(decimalLongitude))
  )

# 3. Realizar Geocodificación Inversa (Reverse Geocoding con OSM)
filas_geocodificadas <- filas_a_procesar %>%
  reverse_geocode(
    lat = lat_num,
    long = lon_num,
    method = "osm",
    full_results = TRUE
  )

# 4. Función auxiliar para extraer columnas de forma segura
obtener_columna_segura <- function(df, nombres_posibles, por_defecto = NA_character_) {
  cols_existentes <- intersect(nombres_posibles, names(df))
  if (length(cols_existentes) == 0) return(rep(por_defecto, nrow(df)))
  
  res <- df[[cols_existentes[1]]]
  if (length(cols_existentes) > 1) {
    for (col in cols_existentes[-1]) {
      res <- coalesce(res, df[[col]])
    }
  }
  return(as.character(res))
}

# 5. Mapear y estandarizar nombres de país en inglés y countryCode en mayúsculas
filas_corregidas <- filas_geocodificadas %>%
  mutate(
    # Código ISO2 bruto en mayúsculas (ej: "US", "BR")
    code_raw = toupper(obtener_columna_segura(., c("country_code"))),
    
    # Asignar countryCode en mayúsculas
    countryCode_nuevo = code_raw,
    
    # Convertir el código al nombre oficial del país en inglés (ej: "United States", "Brazil")
    country_nuevo = countrycode(code_raw, origin = "iso2c", destination = "country.name"),
    
    # Estado / Provincia / Departamento
    state_nuevo = obtener_columna_segura(., c("state", "region", "state_district", "county")),
    
    # Localidad cercana (parque, barrio, ciudad)
    locality_nuevo = obtener_columna_segura(., c("park", "natural", "amenity", "suburb", "neighbourhood", "village", "town", "city", "municipality")),
    
    discardReason_nuevo = "Corrected according to registered location"
  )

# 6. Aplicar las correcciones en 'processed_literature2024'
for (i in seq_len(nrow(filas_corregidas))) {
  idx <- filas_corregidas$fila_id[i]
  
  # Asignar País en Inglés
  if (!is.na(filas_corregidas$country_nuevo[i]) && filas_corregidas$country_nuevo[i] != "") {
    processed_literature2024[idx, "country"] <- filas_corregidas$country_nuevo[i]
  }
  
  # Asignar Código de País en Mayúsculas (US, BR, etc.)
  if (!is.na(filas_corregidas$countryCode_nuevo[i]) && filas_corregidas$countryCode_nuevo[i] != "") {
    processed_literature2024[idx, "countryCode"] <- filas_corregidas$countryCode_nuevo[i]
  }
  
  # Asignar Estado/Provincia
  if (!is.na(filas_corregidas$state_nuevo[i]) && filas_corregidas$state_nuevo[i] != "") {
    processed_literature2024[idx, "stateProvince"] <- filas_corregidas$state_nuevo[i]
  }
  
  # Asignar Localidad cercana
  if (!is.na(filas_corregidas$locality_nuevo[i]) && filas_corregidas$locality_nuevo[i] != "") {
    processed_literature2024[idx, "locality"] <- filas_corregidas$locality_nuevo[i]
  }
  
  # Asignar la razón de corrección en inglés
  processed_literature2024[idx, "discardReason"] <- "Corrected according to registered location"
}

# 7. Limpieza de variables temporales de memoria
rm(filas_a_procesar, filas_geocodificadas, filas_corregidas, obtener_columna_segura)
gc()

# ==============================================================================
# VERIFICACIÓN DE RESULTADOS
# ==============================================================================
processed_literature2024 %>%
  slice(3080:3143) %>%
  filter(!is.na(decimalLatitude) & !is.na(decimalLongitude)) %>%
  select(country, countryCode, stateProvince, locality, discardReason) %>%
  head(15)
```

```{r}
    # Limpiamos espacios extremos para un conteo exacto
    loc_clean = str_trim(as.character(locality)),
    loc_vacía = is.na(loc_clean) | loc_clean == "",

      loc_vacía ~ NA_character_,         # Si está vacía sin esa condición particular, queda NA
```
